safeStructuredRoute.mechanism: Run the same repository-supported dev:auth:up lifecycle through a bounded diagnostic supervisor whose stderr is consumed in memory. Retain only a complete line matching ^DEV_[A-Z0-9_]+(?::DEV_[A-Z0-9_]+)*$ plus numeric child exit status; discard every other stdout/stderr byte and do not read the private ongoing log.
sourceContract: dev-auth-stack-cli.ts catches the lifecycle error, projects DevelopmentAuthStackError through developmentAuthStackErrorCode, writes only the fixed code to stderr, and sets exitCode=1.
developmentAuthStackErrorCode traverses at most four Error causes, retains only messages matching ^DEV_[A-Z0-9_]+$, and otherwise returns DEV_AUTH_STACK_FAILED.

startDevelopmentAuthStack wraps preflight, provider panel, Support model, data, token, environment, API, runner, UI, and TLS stages with fixed DEV_AUTH_STACK_* codes; supervision adds fixed API/UI/RUNNER exited or runtime failure codes.
safeStructuredRoute.privacy: No raw line, environment, provider target, credential, private log byte, or arbitrary exception text is persisted.

boundedPreflight.method: Before restart, call only the existing isPublicPortOccupied operation or perform the same owned port/listener custody check already used by the supported lifecycle.
boundedPreflight.limitation: Public-port preflight can detect occupation but cannot diagnose later stage failures.

requiredNextScope: Separate diagnosis/restart packet authorizing one fixed-code projected supported start, exact owned-port preservation, and normal readiness verification.
